2F.9 Adhere to God's will, for He will try and prove you to see whether or not you will walk in His law and keep His commandments.
2G.6 Do not covenant with the heathen or their gods, or keep company with the heathen and idolaters.
3G.4 We are not to consent with sinners and evildoers, or walk with them, or sit down with them.
4C.2 Bribery condemned as being wicked and perverting justice and judgment.
